parts.description: A black, textured cast iron baking pan featuring six cylindrical cups and two integrated side handles.
parts.reasoning: Visual analysis indicates the object is a solid cast iron muffin or baking pan. The dark, matte, textured surface is highly characteristic of seasoned cast iron, which dictates a high material density (approximately 7200 kg/m³) and a substantial overall mass (estimated at 3.0 kg for this size). Friction coefficients are estimated in the moderate range (0.5 static, 0.4 dynamic) reflecting the slightly rough cast surface interacting with typical robotic grippers or countertops. Restitution is set low (0.3) due to the dense, rigid, non-bouncy nature of thick cast iron. Crucially for Isaac Sim PhysX simulation, the collision geometry must be set to 'convex_decomposition' (using VHACD) or 'sdf_mesh'. A standard 'convex_hull' would stretch across the top, sealing off the baking cups and preventing objects from interacting with the cavities.
